Fixes for applied icons and Restore.

**Download `iconger.exe` below.**

## Fixed
- Icons picked from an `.exe` or `.dll` could go blank later: they pointed straight into that file, so deleting it, or an app update moving it (Discord, some Electron apps), broke the taskbar icon. Every icon you apply is now saved as its own `.ico` in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Iconger\icons`.
- **Restore** now puts back exactly what was there for shortcuts made by installers (icons stored as `%ProgramFiles%\...`). Before, it restored an expanded copy of the path.
- Setting an icon path that uses `%VARS%` could keep showing the old icon. Fixed.
- Store apps you re-pinned through Iconger can now be restored too: **Restore** gives the pin the app's own icon back.
- In icon library results, when two libraries have the same picture, the one listed first is kept (before, it depended on which download finished first).
- Command-line options now work in any order (`--adjust` before `--open` used to be ignored).
- Starting Iconger twice in quick succession no longer opens nothing.

Your backups and settings carry over.
